title: Solid bromine complexing agents: long-term solution for corrosive conditions in redox-flow battery
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,273-280
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00367E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kobby Saadi, Raphael Flack, Valery Bourbo, Ran Elazari, David Zitoun
Herein, we report on a SOLID bromine complexing agent for bromine catholyte of redox-flow batteries. Phase separation from the electrolyte enables safe, efficient and stable energy storage for more than 250 cycles.
